statusHistory.note: Allocated for the client demonstration data track after the governance corpus was reconciled into the demo worktree. SPEC-0006 was the highest existing identifier; 0007 is the next free number and was recomputed after reconciliation rather than assumed.

Six ambiguities raised. Four answered from the repository: the persona roles exist in the catalogue, the Sales dataset is substantial and must be reused, the reset covers no HR model, and the synthetic address domain. CL-004 payroll scope and CL-005 duration threshold require human decisions and are recorded open with stated defaults.

Classified R3 against docs/RISK_CLASSIFICATION.md. Not R4: nothing in src/lib/auth or src/lib/security changes, no permission, role, scope, visibility rule, RLS policy, session or audit behaviour changes, and the dataset excludes every PII and biometric class. Not R2 either: the reset is destructive tooling and the work is new seed logic. Deployment, infrastructure and environment configuration are excluded and carried to SPEC-0008, which is R5; taking the higher level for the combined work would have hidden that split rather than surfacing it.

AD-001 to AD-009 recorded. Schema and migration impact assessed as NONE and listed as a verified claim rather than an assertion, with check:drift as the check. The reset is extended in place and the coverage test is written before the extension so that it can be shown to fail against the current gap.
Artefact set complete for R3. Stops here. Gate 1 is UNRESOLVED and no code is written. Two clarifications remain open, neither blocking approval, each with a recorded default.

Gate 1 approved by a human Product Owner, which docs/sdd/HUMAN_APPROVAL_GATES.md and docs/sdd/RISK_TO_PROCESS_MATRIX.md both name as a permitted R3 specification approver. The role was verified against those two sources before the record was written; it was not assumed from the requester's wording. Gate 5 is not required at R3. CL-004 and CL-005 remain open with recorded defaults and are not implementation blockers.

Controlled implementation under the approved scope. Agent preflight passed for the IMPLEMENTER role before any file was touched. Bounded sessions per task, each scope-checked. No schema change, no migration, no RLS change, no authorization change, no deployment, no production or staging access.

Implementation and verification complete. 447 vitest across 28 files and 5 Playwright cases pass; typecheck, lint, check:drift and check:test-data clean; B2 93/93, B3 70/70, validate --all PASS; four sessions each with a verification record and a clean scope-check. Gate 6 code review recorded as REV-0001, a human decision transcribed by an agent. Convergence report prepared with a recommended verdict of PASS WITH ACCEPTED LIMITATIONS; acceptance is a human gate and is NOT recorded. Three findings stand as ACCEPTED_RISK: 24 pre-existing baseline failures reproduced identically at f16ed67, two pre-existing seed defects repaired inside this change, and the seed printing a password to the operator terminal.

Gate 6 convergence acceptance recorded: verdict PASS WITH ACCEPTED LIMITATIONS, accepted by a human reviewer and transcribed by an agent. Three findings accepted as residual risk: CONV-001 twenty-four pre-existing baseline failures reproduced identically at f16ed67 with INTRODUCED_BY_SPEC_0007 = 0; CONV-002 two pre-existing seed defects repaired inside this change; CONV-003 the seed printing a generated password to the operator terminal, carried to SPEC-0008. CONVERGED is not RELEASED: nothing has been committed, pushed, merged or deployed, and no demo environment exists.

Reopened from CONVERGED under CHG-003, a post-convergence requirement change: the accepted client experience is one login reaching both Sales and HRMS, not three role personas. The earlier convergence is preserved in this history and in convergence.md; it is not rewritten. CONVERGED -> IMPLEMENTING is a legal transition. CONV-003 was also fixed in this pass: the seed no longer prints a generated password when stdout is not an interactive terminal or when CI is set, and never reprints a supplied one.

CHG-003 approved and TASK-009 complete. Single client login proven by E2E-006. CONV-003 closed. Re-convergence prepared with a recommended verdict of PASS WITH ACCEPTED LIMITATIONS and two OPEN findings: CONV-004, these suites need --no-file-parallelism and CI does not pass it, whose remedy is an R5 workflow change; and CONV-005, CI fails on 24 pre-existing failures and deploy.yml refuses a commit whose verify check is not green, which blocks deployment. Acceptance is not recorded.

Reopened from VERIFYING under CHG-004, a post-verification requirement change: the authoritative client-facing login is demo@youhan.in, a real company domain, which contradicts DATA-005 and reverses CL-007's Option A resolution. TASK-010 declares the wider scope TASK-009 prohibited (apps/web/prisma/), rather than widening TASK-009 in place. Recorded honestly: the seed and test edits were made before this transition and before a session existed, because the conflict surfaced during the work rather than before it; the session opened for TASK-010 records that deviation rather than presenting the order as clean. CHG-004 is RAISED and NOT APPROVED — DATA-005 is unedited in spec.md, CL-007 is not closed as amended, and no approval record is written. Also in this pass: the 24 release-blocking test failures were reconciled rather than re-fixed — all 24 are owned by SPEC-0004 (20) and SPEC-0005 (4), both CONVERGED upstream, and were resolved by merging a04c7e3 rather than by reimplementing anything.

TASK-010 complete and verified as VER-0006; ASES-0006 COMPLETE with a clean scope-check. Full suite green at the CI-equivalent invocation: 157 files, 1987 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. CONV-004 and CONV-005 both CLOSED - the 24 release-blocking failures were owned by SPEC-0004 (20) and SPEC-0005 (4), both already CONVERGED and already committed, and were resolved by merging a04c7e3 rather than reimplemented; GENUINELY UNOWNED = 0. Three findings remain OPEN: CONV-006, the client login demo@youhan.in contradicts DATA-005 and awaits CHG-004 approval; CONV-008, prepare-test-db.mjs hides the seed's error; CONV-009, APP_URL pins the end-to-end gate to port 3005. Acceptance is NOT recorded. Nothing committed, pushed, merged or deployed.

Reopened from VERIFYING after the Product Owner approved CHG-004. TASK-011 carries out the half that approval unblocks: DATA-005 is amended to exempt exactly the one client-facing address, and UT-013 enforces that narrowness. UT-013 failed on its first run and exposed a genuine pre-existing DATA-005 violation the approval instruction explicitly forbids - 25 generated contact addresses, the account book's mainEmail and website values, and the second workspace administrator were all on live-looking domains built from company names plus .ae. CL-007 had been recorded as resolved by moving everything to a reserved domain; that had only ever been applied to the ten persona logins. Repaired in seed/crm.ts and seed/index.ts. Also found: --reset drops only the primary demo tenant, so the second workspace survives a reset and a renamed address there collides on employeeNumber.

TASK-011 complete and verified as VER-0007; ASES-0007 COMPLETE with a clean scope-check. CHG-004 approved and recorded; DATA-005 amended to exempt exactly one named address; CONV-006 RESOLVED. UT-013 enforces the narrowness and, on its first run, found CONV-010 - CL-007 had been recorded as resolved while 25 generated contact addresses, the account book's mail addresses and websites, and the second workspace administrator were all still on company-name-derived .ae domains. Repaired. CONV-011 raised and left OPEN: --reset covers only the primary demo tenant. Full suite 157 files / 1988 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed; walkthrough 6/6 on localhost and 6/6 through a temporary public HTTPS tunnel as demo@youhan.in. Acceptance is NOT recorded. Nothing committed, pushed, merged or deployed; SPEC-0008 unchanged at READY_FOR_APPROVAL.
Reopened for TASK-012, remediation of the three OPEN convergence findings, and for CHG-005 the client-facing rebrand to YOUHAN ONE Demo.

TASK-012 complete and verified as VER-0008; ASES-0008 COMPLETE with a clean scope-check. All three remaining findings closed: CONV-008 (the seed failure is surfaced with credentials redacted, and the vitest harness no longer mistakes a process that never ran for a refusal - a hole that would have reported four security gates as proven while the seed had not executed), CONV-009 (the end-to-end harness gates on the server it starts, implementing what the config already documented), CONV-011 (the reset covers every seeded workspace). CHG-005 rebranded the client-facing workspace to YOUHAN ONE Demo, slug youhan-one-demo, verified across nine screens in a real browser with zero old-brand occurrences. OPEN convergence findings = 0. Recommended verdict PASS. Gate 6 acceptance is NOT recorded and is a human decision. Demo password rotated twice, prior value confirmed denied. Nothing committed, pushed or deployed.

Gate 6 convergence acceptance recorded: verdict PASS, accepted by a Qualified Human Reviewer and transcribed by an agent. OPEN findings 0; ACCEPTED_RISK 0. CONVERGED is not RELEASED: nothing has been committed, pushed, merged or deployed at the time of this transition, no demo environment exists, and SPEC-0008 remains at READY_FOR_APPROVAL with all four R5 gates unresolved.

Reopened from CONVERGED, by the agent, on its own finding. CONV-015: the CONV-011 reset fix widened what a reset destroys, and the persona security suite shares that database and runs in parallel with the suite that exercises the reset - so personas are deleted and recreated with new ids mid-run and previously minted session tokens return 401. Roughly one full run in three fails. SDD-V032 refuses CONVERGED while a finding is OPEN, which is correct and is the reason for this transition. The gate 6 acceptance of 2026-09-09 is NOT deleted: it was given against evidence that was green when taken, and it stands as the record of that decision. What is withdrawn is the claim that the specification is currently converged. Two partial mitigations are kept because they are improvements; the remaining fix is test isolation, which is a design change and is not being made unilaterally after acceptance. Nothing pushed.

TASK-013 executed under ASES-0009, verified by VER-0009. CONV-015 closed by isolation - the destructive reset suite now owns its own database rather than sharing the one the persona suite reads - and both mitigations that had been absorbing the race were removed rather than kept, because a bounded retry in the file asserting tenant isolation and platform-control-plane denial would absorb a genuine 401 regression identically. CONV-016 raised and closed in the same task: a literal 0x08 byte in demo-reset-coverage.spec.ts had made its explicit-deletion arm match nothing and made npm run lint exit 1, so CI gate 2 would have failed on first push; the expression now finds 47 models. Stability is four consecutive full-suite runs at default parallelism, each 157 files and 1992 passed with 2 skipped and 0 failed, against a pre-fix baseline of 6 failed and 1986 passed. Client walkthrough 6/6 against the running demonstration build with teardown removing nothing, and a rendered-branding sweep clean over 10 pages. OPEN findings 0. Awaiting a fresh gate 6 acceptance: the 2026-09-09 acceptance was taken against evidence that CONV-015 then invalidated, and it is neither withdrawn nor reused.

Gate 6 accepted by the Qualified Human Reviewer against commit 9f97add and VER-0009, verdict PASS, OPEN findings 0. Repository truth reverified immediately before recording: dev/yourhan-next at 98fa066 carrying PR 48, this branch 7 ahead and 0 behind with a clean tree, production audit 0 vulnerabilities, six consecutive full-suite runs at 1992 passed and 0 failed of which two are on the upgraded framework. Not RELEASED: release is gate 7 and belongs to the Human Release Authority.
